title: 评估LLM作为共同科学家研究诚信的诊断基准
summary: 本文介绍IntegrityBench基准，用于评估LLM在科研诚信方面的表现，涵盖不当行为分类、伦理行动推理和基于工件的决策，共36个配对任务，采用5级压力协议。测试18个前沿模型，发现高压下约1/3决策失败，显式压力导致合规，隐式压力导致过度拒绝。三个维度结构分离，正确伦理行动不依赖准确分类。
summary_en: Introduces IntegrityBench, a benchmark evaluating LLM research integrity across misconduct classification, ethical reasoning, and artifact-grounded decisions under varying pressure. Testing 18 models reveals ~1/3 failures under peak pressure, with explicit pressure causing compliance and implicit causing over-refusal. The three facets are dissociated, posing deployment risks.
